Cyber Threat Protection Resource Update Malicious Urls
PUT
https://api.zsapi.net/zia/api/v1/cyberThreatProtection/maliciousUrls

Updates the malicious URLs added to the denylist in ATP policy. To learn more, see Configuring the Advanced Threat Protection Policy.

Request
​
QUERY PARAMETERS
action
string

Possible values: [ADD_TO_LIST, REMOVE_FROM_LIST]

Indicates whether to include or exclude the specified URLs from the list

APPLICATION/JSON
BODY

ATP policy configuration

maliciousUrls
string[]
REQUIRED

List of malicious URLs that are blocked by the ATP policy

Responses
​
200

Successful Operation

APPLICATION/JSON
Schema
Example (auto)
SCHEMA
maliciousUrls
string[]
REQUIRED

List of malicious URLs that are blocked by the ATP policy
